title: Reptiles: spot the Critically Endangered
intro: Conservation status of reptiles, using the IUCN Red List categories as recorded on Wikidata.

questions.prompt: Which of these species is recorded as Critically Endangered?
questions.explain: Atlantic Ridley: Critically Endangered. European ratsnake: Least Concern; Reticulated python: Least Concern; emerald tree boa: Least Concern. Status as recorded on Wikidata (IUCN Red List categories), retrieved 2026-10-12.
